what_was_found.shape: 1024,4096 -> 4096,1024, about 40 occurrences a forward i.e. once a layer
what_was_found.cause: attention.py:1688-1689 reads the o-projection weight as [groups, o_lora_rank, d] and einsums over d, so the framework materialises a transpose of that constant weight before the matmul, every layer, every token
what_was_found.why_it_looked_attractive: the weight is constant during a decode, so transposing it once per module looks like removing repeated work; and a transpose changes no value

what_was_measured.claim_under_test: same products, same ascending reduction over d, constant storage layout only, therefore bit-identical
what_was_measured.result_contiguous_pretranspose: 3 of 6 trials in the first test and 5 of 8 in the second were NOT bit-identical; 1 to 2 of 2048 elements differ, max abs up to 0.5
what_was_measured.verdict: the reduction order is NOT layout-invariant on this build. The faster variant changes results every time; the variant that sometimes matches is slower than the status quo.

conclusion: The 1171.6 us transpose cannot be removed bit-exactly, and no variant is both exact and faster. Recorded as a negative result; the change was not adopted.

available_only_with_approval.class: bf16 reduction-order deviation in the o-projection (wo_a) matmul
available_only_with_approval.mechanism: append .transpose(1, 2) to the matmul operand instead of a materialised [g, d, r] copy
available_only_with_approval.expected_gain: the op drops from about 165.7 us to 99.6 us eagerly, so roughly 0.5 to 0.7 ms a forward, about 0.7 to 1.0% of the step
available_only_with_approval.observed_error: 0 of 8 trials bit-identical; where differences appear it is 1 to 2 of 2048 elements, max abs up to 0.5 on bf16
available_only_with_approval.why_it_needs_approval: the objective forbids new quality relaxation without explicit scoped approval; this is a different op and a different class from the existing row-norm and narrow-head approvals, so those receipts do not cover it
available_only_with_approval.status: NOT adopted. Offered to the user as a decision, with the measured error, not as an optimisation already taken.

second_layout_item_not_yet_pursued.observation: 138 is exactly the call count of _state_post_pv_kernel and _state_prepare_kernel, so these small 1,1,512 index-copy-transposes belong to the sparse-attention state machinery

method: standalone bit-exactness harness on the device before any lane change; no model run, no code change adopted
